source: This publication is one of the many newsrooms closest to achieving racial parity in the US.
why: The closest-parity ranking depends on hand-selected larger geographies; for example, the chart shows Minneapolis at city parity against a geography much whiter than Minneapolis. census_4.csv has only city-level percentages, so the city-only comparison does not reproduce the chart's set of closest newsrooms.
